literal_meaning: পেটে থাকা (stomach-এ থাকা বা remain in the stomach)
figurative_meaning_en: to digest properly or to sit well (especially referring to food)
similar_in_english: It doesn't sit well with me
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই খাবার আমার পেটে থাকে না।
ভালো করে রান্না করলে খাবার পেটে থাকে।
example_sentences_in_english: This food doesn't stay in my stomach.
If cooked properly, the food digests well.
note: Commonly used in contexts of dietary intolerance or poor digestion in everyday Bengali speech.
